# A09-D07: Grant application

Grant application. Identifying collaborator and private artist-fee figures omitted. Event methods, projected participation, other budget items and historical claims remain unchanged.

MindFuture’s application to The Cultural Council, Høje Taastrup Municipality
On the occasion of the Vestegnen Culture Week2022 MindFuture at Erik Husfeldts Vej 7 will host two art events about democracy and artificial intelligence that relate to the municipality’s theme
of open cultural communities. We hereby apply for support to honor two artists, while
MindFuture covers all other expenses related to holding the events.
The format is a “voter meeting” for the project The Synthetic Party, which is driven by the artist and
philosopher [the operator]. Over two afternoons in the weekend 
 September, the party10/11will invite ordinary people into a culture where machines set the agenda. For this,
we expect to engage 
 people over the two days. Through a collaboration200-400with the Høje Taastrup Libraries, the artists will tailor the format so that it can be included in
the Culture Package, allowing us to invite school classes of the graduating age.
About The Synthetic Party
The Synthetic Party was launched in June 
 and has received considerable media attention. The party is2022led by an artificial intelligence that has read all the crazy and wild ideas that completely ordinary
people have written on the internet in connection with their private establishment of small parties. In this
way, the party can demonstrate what kinds of political representation become possible
with artificial intelligence and show ordinary citizens’ visions without a human filter.
Specifically about the events
The two events will take the form of hands-on workshops where [the operator] 
 guides people in communicating with a political chatbot, [████] creating logos and icons with artificial intelligence, and producing digital poetry with both words
and images through technology. Participants will, perhaps for the first time, try to talk to an AI,
participate in “policy development,” and learn tools to program themselves with easy
and publicly available machine learning tools.
The two artists will create a situation where participants are members of The Synthetic
Party and thus will feel that they have the possibility to influence the technology –
rather than it influencing them. The purpose is thereby to strengthen democratic
education so that new phenomena like ‘spam bots’ and ‘troll armies’ do not appear as alien creatures from another world, but as something
one can understand and take responsibility for.

Budget 
[████]
 Entrance fee: 0 kr 
 Drinks and food: 5000 kroner (free for visitors) 
 Payment for a guard to keep open over the weekend: 5000 kroner 
 Advertising expenses (Kultunaut, local newspaper, Facebook, LinkedIn): 2500 
[████]
 Other expenses are covered by MindFuture.
